The added specs are all isolated/unit-style: embed_controller_spec stubs TopicEmbed.topic_id_for_embed and mocks TopicRetriever; topic_retriever_spec mocks perform_retrieve/retrieved_recently?; poll_feed_spec only checks gating; topic_embed_spec only exercises TopicEmbed.import (not import_remote/readability/open-uri, nor the controller/job/view end-to-end).
